title: Static NAT and Inside Server Publishing
summary: Configure and verify one-to-one Static NAT on a Cisco edge router to publish an internal enterprise server to external internet clients via a dedicated public IPv4 address, while preserving private host isolation.
learning_objectives: Understand the architectural principles and operational use cases of one-to-one Static Network Address Translation
Distinguish between Inside Local, Inside Global, Outside Local, and Outside Global address classifications
Designate internal private and external public boundaries using ip nat inside and ip nat outside
Configure a persistent one-to-one translation mapping using the ip nat inside source static command
Verify bidirectional address translation and external host isolation using show ip nat translations and ICMP verification

source.origin: Independently authored network services curriculum guide based on IETF RFC 3022 standards and Cisco IOS Static NAT documentation
